chunks: Abu al-Jaroud asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
About a man who dies: should his nails be trimmed, his armpit hair plucked, and his pubic hair shaved if, because of illness, they had become long?

key_terms.لَا: no; indicating prohibition or negation in this context

ai.seo_question: Should the nails or body hair of a deceased person be trimmed before burial in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the preparation of the deceased. It indicates that the nails and body hair of the dead person are not to be trimmed or removed, even if illness had caused them to grow long.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.418 - Abu al-Jaroud asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)
about a man who passed away: Should his nails be trimmed, his armpit hair plucked, or his pubic hair shaved if he had been bedridden for a long period?
